Data cleaning, rename the columns to match scale names with corresponding items

# Import the client data

cleaned_data_evan_s26 <- read_csv("cleaned_data_evan_s26.csv")
## New names:
## Rows: 554 Columns: 188
## ── Column specification
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Delimiter: "," chr
## (7): timestamp, event_n, event_t, gender, major, international, AID dbl (181):
## ...1, event_v, ces1, ces2, ces3, ces4, ces5, ces6, ces7, ces8, ce...
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data. ℹ
## Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
## • `` -> `...1`
namesfile_evan_s26 <- read_csv("namesfile_evan_s26.csv")
## Rows: 193 Columns: 4
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (3): oldnames, newnames, scale
## lgl (1): reverse_coding
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
# Match scale with the item names

rename_vec <- namesfile_evan_s26 %>%
  filter(!is.na(scale)) %>%
  mutate(temp_name = paste0(scale, "_", newnames)) %>%
  select(newnames, temp_name)

cleaned <- cleaned_data_evan_s26 %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ rename_vec$temp_name[match(., rename_vec$newnames)],
    .cols = any_of(rename_vec$newnames)
  )

# Compute Row means aggregated by scale and facet

## Row means function
compute_rowmeans <- function(data, scale){
  ifelse(rowSums(!is.na(data %>% dplyr::select(starts_with(scale)))) >= (sum(startsWith(names(data),scale))/2),
   rowMeans(data %>% dplyr::select(starts_with(scale)), na.rm = TRUE),
   NA)
}

## Finding subfacets function
compute_rowmeans_subfacet <- function(data, scale) {
  
  cols <- names(data)[grepl(paste0("^", scale, "[0-9]+$"), names(data))]
  
  if (length(cols) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))
  
  
  ifelse(
    rowSums(!is.na(data[, cols, drop = FALSE])) >= ceiling(length(cols) / 2),
    rowMeans(data[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    NA_real_
  )
}

compute_all_rowmeans_prefix <- function(data, prefix_filter) {
  
  vars <- names(data)[grepl(paste0("^", prefix_filter, ".*[0-9]+$"), names(data))]
  prefixes <- unique(sub("[0-9]+$", "", vars))
  
  for (p in prefixes) {
    data[[p]] <- compute_rowmeans_subfacet(data, p)
  }
  
  data
}

# Create the final dataset for use

cleaned <- compute_all_rowmeans_prefix(cleaned, "change7_") %>%
  mutate(change7_ipip_n = compute_rowmeans(., "change7_ipip_n"),
         change7_ipip_e = compute_rowmeans(., "change7_ipip_e"),
         change7_ipip_o = compute_rowmeans(., "change7_ipip_o"),
         change7_ipip_a = compute_rowmeans(., "change7_ipip_a"),
         change7_ipip_c = compute_rowmeans(., "change7_ipip_c"))

(Visualization I) Correlation Barplot 1, No centering(fold)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
## 
## Attaching package: 'scales'
## The following object is masked from 'package:purrr':
## 
##     discard
## The following object is masked from 'package:readr':
## 
##     col_factor
relevant_vars <- c(
  "change7_ipip_e", "change7_ipip_o", "change7_ipip_n", "change7_ipip_a", "change7_ipip_c",
  "change7_growth_m", "change7_growth_a", "change7_growth_n", "change7_growth_p",
  "change7_growth_spirit", "change7_growth_r", "change7_growth_self"
)

cor_matrix_relevant <- cor_matrix[relevant_vars, "valence6_event_v", drop = FALSE]

cor_df <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(cor_matrix_relevant),
  correlation = cor_matrix_relevant[, "valence6_event_v"]
) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_label = recode(
      variable,
      "change7_ipip_e" = "Extraversion",
      "change7_ipip_o" = "Openness",
      "change7_ipip_n" = "Neuroticism",
      "change7_ipip_a" = "Agreeableness",
      "change7_ipip_c" = "Conscientiousness",
      "change7_growth_m" = "Meaning in Life",
      "change7_growth_a" = "Appreciation for Life",
      "change7_growth_n" = "New Possibilities",
      "change7_growth_p" = "Personal Strength",
      "change7_growth_spirit" = "Spirituality",
      "change7_growth_r" = "Relationships",
      "change7_growth_self" = "Self Esteem"
    ),
    abs_corr = abs(correlation),
    cor_label = sprintf("%.2f", correlation)
  )

x_min <- floor(min(cor_df$correlation) / 0.1) * 0.1
x_max <- ceiling(max(cor_df$correlation) / 0.1) * 0.1

p <- ggplot(
  cor_df,
  aes(
    x = correlation,
    y = fct_reorder(variable_label, correlation),
    fill = abs_corr
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = cor_label,
      hjust = ifelse(correlation >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)
    ),
    size = 5.2,
    family = "Times New Roman"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, by = 0.1),
    limits = c(x_min - 0.05, x_max + 0.05),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#cfd6e6",
    high = "#2f477a",
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlations Between Valence and Personality/Growth Facets",
    x = "Pearson correlation with Valence",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 18, r = 35, b = 12, l = 20)
  )

p

Factor Analysis

EFA for Each Dimension

library(lavaan)
## This is lavaan 0.6-21
## lavaan is FREE software! Please report any bugs.
#dataset for factor analysis (only contains the interest data points)
facA_data <- cleaned[5:182]

growth_vars <- grep("(^growth_|_growth_)", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)
growth_data <- facA_data[, growth_vars, drop = FALSE]
growth_data$change7_growth_r4 <- dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(growth_data$change7_growth_r4) ~ NA_real_,
  growth_data$change7_growth_r4 %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
  growth_data$change7_growth_r4 == 3 ~ 2,
  growth_data$change7_growth_r4 == 4 ~ 3,
  growth_data$change7_growth_r4 == 5 ~ 4,
  growth_data$change7_growth_r4 == 6 ~ 5,
  growth_data$change7_growth_r4 == 7 ~ 6
)

fit_growth_7 <- lavaan::efa(
  data = growth_data,
  nfactors = 7,
  rotation = "oblimin",
  ordered = T
)

CES and Growth

library(lavaan)

growth_np <- grep("growth_n", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)        # New Possibilities
growth_ps <- grep("growth_p", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)        # Personal Strength
growth_rel <- grep("growth_r", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)       # Relationships
growth_app <- grep("growth_a", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)       # Appreciation for Life
growth_sp <- grep("growth_spirit", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)   # Spirituality
growth_mean <- grep("growth_m", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)      # Meaning in Life
growth_self <- grep("growth_self", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)   # Self Esteem

# CFA structure
CG_7_structure <- paste0(
  "ces =~ ", paste(ces_vars, collapse = " + "), "\n",

  "new_possibilities =~ ", paste(growth_np, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "personal_strength =~ ", paste(growth_ps, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "relationships =~ ", paste(growth_rel, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "appreciation_life =~ ", paste(growth_app, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "spirituality =~ ", paste(growth_sp, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "meaning_life =~ ", paste(growth_mean, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "self_esteem =~ ", paste(growth_self, collapse = " + "), "\n",

  "ces ~~ new_possibilities\n",
  "ces ~~ personal_strength\n",
  "ces ~~ relationships\n",
  "ces ~~ appreciation_life\n",
  "ces ~~ spirituality\n",
  "ces ~~ meaning_life\n",
  "ces ~~ self_esteem\n"
)

cfa_cg_7 <- cfa(
  model = CG_7_structure,
  data = facA_data,
  ordered = T
)

library(mirt)
library(dplyr)

mirt_syntax_cg <- paste0(
  "
  CES = ", paste(ces_vars, collapse = ", "), "

  NewPossibilities = ", paste(growth_np, collapse = ", "), "
  PersonalStrength = ", paste(growth_ps, collapse = ", "), "
  Relationships = ", paste(growth_rel, collapse = ", "), "
  AppreciationLife = ", paste(growth_app, collapse = ", "), "
  Spirituality = ", paste(growth_sp, collapse = ", "), "
  MeaningLife = ", paste(growth_mean, collapse = ", "), "
  SelfEsteem = ", paste(growth_self, collapse = ", "), "

  COV = CES*NewPossibilities,
        CES*PersonalStrength,
        CES*Relationships,
        CES*AppreciationLife,
        CES*Spirituality,
        CES*MeaningLife,
        CES*SelfEsteem
  "
)

cg_mirt_model <- mirt(
  data = facA_data %>% 
    select(all_of(c(
      ces_vars,
      growth_np,
      growth_ps,
      growth_rel,
      growth_app,
      growth_sp,
      growth_mean,
      growth_self
    ))),
  model = mirt_syntax_cg,
  itemtype = "graded",
  method = "MHRM",
  verbose = FALSE
)

fscores(
  cg_mirt_model,
  QMC = TRUE,
  returnER = TRUE
)

library(lavaan)
library(qgraph)

pe <- standardizedSolution(cfa_cg_7)

ces_edges <- subset(
  pe,
  op == "~~" &
    lhs == "ces" &
    rhs %in% c(
      "new_possibilities",
      "personal_strength",
      "relationships",
      "appreciation_life",
      "spirituality",
      "meaning_life",
      "self_esteem"
    )
)

nodes <- c(
  "ces",
  "new_possibilities",
  "personal_strength",
  "relationships",
  "appreciation_life",
  "spirituality",
  "meaning_life",
  "self_esteem"
)

mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(nodes), ncol = length(nodes))
rownames(mat) <- nodes
colnames(mat) <- nodes

layout_mat <- matrix(c(
   0,    0,     # CES center
   0,    1.6,   # New Possibilities
   1.4,  0.8,   # Personal Strength
   1.6, -0.2,   # Relationships
   0.8, -1.3,   # Appreciation for Life
  -0.8, -1.3,   # Spirituality
  -1.6, -0.2,   # Meaning in Life
  -1.4,  0.8    # Self Esteem
), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ces_edges))) {
  mat[ces_edges$lhs[i], ces_edges$rhs[i]] <- ces_edges$est.std[i]
  mat[ces_edges$rhs[i], ces_edges$lhs[i]] <- ces_edges$est.std[i]
}

# Clean labels
labels <- c(
  "CES",
  "New\nPossibilities",
  "Personal\nStrength",
  "Relationships",
  "Appreciation\nfor Life",
  "Spirituality",
  "Meaning\nin Life",
  "Self\nEsteem"
)

png(
  filename = "ces_growth_7factor_plot.png",
  width = 1400,
  height = 1000,
  res = 150
)

plot_obj <- qgraph(
  mat,
  layout = layout_mat,
  labels = labels,
  edge.labels = TRUE,
  edge.label.cex = 1.5,
  edge.color = "navy",
  vsize = 14,
  label.cex = 1.2,
  minimum = 0,
  cut = 0,
  DoNotPlot = FALSE
)

dev.off()

##   2

CES and IPIP

library(lavaan)
ipip_n <- grep("ipip_n", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)  # Neuroticism
ipip_e <- grep("ipip_e", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)  # Extraversion
ipip_o <- grep("ipip_o", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)  # Openness
ipip_a <- grep("ipip_a", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)  # Agreeableness
ipip_c <- grep("ipip_c", names(facA_data), value = TRUE)  # Conscientiousness

CI_5_structure <- paste0(
  "ces =~ ", paste(ces_vars, collapse = " + "), "\n",

  "neuroticism =~ ", paste(ipip_n, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "extraversion =~ ", paste(ipip_e, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "openness =~ ", paste(ipip_o, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "agreeableness =~ ", paste(ipip_a, collapse = " + "), "\n",
  "conscientiousness =~ ", paste(ipip_c, collapse = " + "), "\n",

  "ces ~~ neuroticism\n",
  "ces ~~ extraversion\n",
  "ces ~~ openness\n",
  "ces ~~ agreeableness\n",
  "ces ~~ conscientiousness\n"
)

cfa_ci_5 <- cfa(
  model = CI_5_structure,
  data = facA_data,
  ordered = T
)

summary(
  cfa_ci_5,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE
)
CES with IPIP factor Std.all p-value
Openness 0.418 < .001
Extraversion 0.408 < .001
Agreeableness 0.268 < .001
Conscientiousness 0.263 < .001
Neuroticism -0.134 .001

Note: It takes significantly long time to run the CFA on CES and IPIP, therefore I manually recorded the analysis results from previous sessions. For validation, it is suggested to run the chunk again.

  edge.label.cex = 1.8,
  edge.color = ifelse(mat > 0, "navy", "lightcoral"),
  vsize = c(20, 14, 14, 14, 14, 14),
  label.cex = 1.5,
  minimum = 0,
  cut = 0,
  borders = TRUE
)

dev.off()
